data_status: STRICT MODE: this dataset contains only values that were compared with, or ingested directly from, retrieved sources: JPL (SSD, SBDB, NHATS), NASA (NSSDC fact sheets and mission catalog, Small Spacecraft SoA report 2026, SLS page, Apollo 11 press kit, NTRS papers, data.nasa.gov), ULA, ESA, NIST, and the Launch Library 2 aggregator. Records carry source_authority/confidence where the source is an aggregator or vendor-reported compilation. Recalled, estimated and fictional values (optimizer catalog, costs, engine/vehicle specs without a retrievable source, the user-supplied SpaceX table) are not included. Derived values are computed only from verified inputs and are labelled derived.

record.name: Mast Camera (Mastcam)
record.description: The Mast Camera (MastCam) is mounted on the central mast of the rover and is designed to take images of the martian terrain and atmospheric phenomena, and to support driving and science functions of the rover. MastCam comprises two cameras. One, M-34, has a 34 mm focal length and f/8 lens with a 15 x 20 degree field of view and a 1200 x 1600 pixel image size. The other camera, M-100, has a 100 mm focal length and f/10 lens with a 5.1 x 6.8 degree field of view and a 1200 x 1600 pixel image size. Both camerascan focus from about 2.1 m to infinity. The pixel scale at 1 km for M-34 is 22 cm and for M-100 is 7.4 cm. For more detailed information, see: http://msl-scicorner.jpl.nasa.gov/Instruments/Mastcam/
